decisions.decision: A blank site needs BOTH deploy_checkmk_data and deploy_mosquitto_data removed
decisions.rationale: The dashboard reads only MQTT retained messages; the poller tombstones a device only when it sees it leave a running site, so a Checkmk wipe leaves ghost hosts in the broker volume
